ValidationRule.description: Rule for mandatory Terms and Conditions.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && ISPICKVAL(ER_BUPicklist__c, "BENELUX") && NOT(ISPICKVAL( $User.UserType ,"AutomatedProcess")) && (ISBLANK(TEXT(ER_PaymentMethod__c)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(ER_PaymentTerms__c)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(ERBE_Invoicing_Support__c)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(ER_InvoicingFrequency__c)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(ER_ReimbursementTerm__c)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(ERBE_Reimbursement_Statement_Frequency__c)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(ERBE_Reimbursement_Statement_Support__c)) || (ISPICKVAL(ER_InvoicingFrequency__c, "Weekly") && ISBLANK(TEXT(ERBE_Invoicing_day_of_week__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: VRBE07 - Terms and Conditions fields are mandatory.
